summary: Feature request to support dynamic per-call activity summaries that vary based on runtime context (agent, arguments, reasoning stage) instead of static strings, critical for debugging multi-agent workflows in the Temporal UI.
userImpact: Users building multi-agent workflows cannot effectively trace and debug activities in Temporal UI because all invocations display identical static summaries.
rootCause: ActivityConfig.summary parameter only accepts static strings with no mechanism to access runtime request data or tool arguments at call time.
proposedFix: Implement dynamic summary generation via callback, format string, or template that provides access to LlmRequest context for TemporalModel and tool arguments for activity_tool, with sensitive argument redaction.
workaround: Subclass TemporalModel and extend activity_tool to generate per-call summaries from runtime arguments (as demonstrated in Fleet Agent implementation).
keyQuote: Dynamic per-call activity summaries are a significant quality-of-life improvement for multi-agent workflows — static summaries make the Temporal UI nearly useless for tracing incidents
